evidence.quote: The BSc in Industrial Engineering is organised in a three-year structure
Entirely taught in English and located in one of Italy’s most vibrant production ecosystems

notes: Tuition fee: no amount in EUR for a non-EU Bachelor applicant living abroad is stated on the supplied pages. The main tuition page (https://www.polimi.it/studenti/tasse-universitarie) contains an ISEE-based table of bands and figures such as 'prima rata di 880,04 €' and 'seconda rata (da un minimo di € 0 , ad un massimo di €3.003,00)' which is not a single stated amount or a lowest/highest pair for a non-EU student; the 'Studenti con reddito e patrimonio all'estero' page describes the ISEEU parificato procedure but states no fee amount. Tuition therefore left out. Application channel: no supplied page mentions Universitaly or a university application portal for this specific Bachelor programme, so applicationChannel is left out. Application deadlines: none of the supplied pages state a dated application deadline for non-EU/international applicants. Duration evidence confirms 3 years.

note.fr: Admission to the Bachelor's degree requires passing an entrance test (TOL, TOLC-I, SAT or CEnT-S). Check the admission procedures on the university website.
